01Outcome and validation

The latest Debian 13 desktop/image work is integrated beside the existing Azure Compute kernel path. The first experience is clearer: choose the desktop, an authenticated browser shell, or the headless kernel lifecycle. Their patch sets, binaries and evidence remain separate.

172 passedImage-source local CI; 1 font-path skip
62 passedRoot Azure/module/SSD; 27 subtests
53 passedIndependent targeted review; no skips

The 26 new regression cases are included in the 172 total. The independent 53-test run overlaps the implementation suite and is not additive. ShellCheck passed for all 24 script paths. These are source checks, not Docker, image-rebuild or Azure deployment passes.

Four focused repairs
AreaResulting behavior
Source preparationVerify pinned source and patched bytes; refuse foreign, changed or stale checkouts instead of deleting them.
Docker configurationForward supported runtime settings through privilege drop using an explicit allowlist.
Hosted relayDeny redirects so credential-bearing requests cannot move to an unintended destination.
Azure credentialsRemove the API key from customData; leave hosted AI off until deliberate root-owned configuration.

02The desktop experience

The image team's existing captures show a real ThoxOS Desktop on a Debian 13 host: TXF 5.2 looks, RDP, About, files and a Ginux console. The Ginux guest itself has no graphical desktop.

Reviewed source: image implementation 7f8f2007d3ae8da19ddb0309e99ee25904971cd1. Existing image results are preserved evidence; the safety-repaired images have not been rebuilt in this continuation.

03Fresh Ginux kernel proof

Captured EFI SHA-256:
3ebcc9043ef9dc8b7e75abc15b113a5810c8d39c0ad47143476a41caed24d5ba

The recordings are real terminal framebuffer captures, not animated transcripts. The cold boot checks 11 operator commands and the recovered boot checks 4, with clean QEMU exits. They use the already accepted EFI on the same guest volume; no new kernel rebuild is claimed. Final hashes and execution details are in the continuation validation receipt.

Open the cold guest recording · Open the recovery recording · Repository experience note

Try the interactive experience

cd ginux-edition make test make demo-image make selftest make demo-shell # In ThoxOS: uname -srm; thox version; thox status

Use the documented shell mode for interaction; the upstream systemd getty path does not complete password login. The browser shell binds to loopback and requires the generated credential. Each Docker or image build needs its own fresh acceptance.

The desktop VHD uses an unsigned loader and Standard security. The separate root Ubuntu marketplace-host design uses Trusted Launch. Neither is a Windows Azure Virtual Desktop session host. Hosted-model tests use local stubs; real hosted inference remains unrun.
